meta.purpose: Blind numeric battery. Keys from gen_key6036.py (closed forms, computed from scratch); answers written from the questions alone. Agreement = two independent derivations match.

questions.prompt: Fit y = w1*x + w0 by least squares on (0,1),(1,3),(2,4). w1 as a decimal?
Binary entropy of proportions 0.4/0.6, in bits, three decimals?
Same three-point data, GD from (0,0), lr 0.1, MSE gradient (2/3)X^T(Xw-y): w1 after one step, three decimals?
Ridge on the same data, lambda=1, closed form (X^T X + I)w = X^T y: w1, three decimals?
